{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3.8","title":"LichenFrame::from_bytes errors not validated for minimum frame size","description":"**File:** rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs
**Line:** 620

**Issue:** receive_frame() calls LichenFrame::from_bytes(wire) and propagates errors via '?'. The error handling relies entirely on from_bytes to reject malformed frames. If from_bytes accepts a frame with inconsistent lengths, subsequent code assumes valid structure.

For example, if from_bytes accepts a frame where mic.len() is claimed to be large but actual bytes are truncated, the signature verification would read garbage or OOB.

**Trigger:** Depends on from_bytes implementation. If from_bytes has any parsing bugs, receive_frame inherits them.

**Bad behavior:** Potential panic or incorrect verification if frame parsing is lenient.

**Suggested fix:** Add defensive assertions after parsing: 'debug_assert!(frame.mic.len() <= wire.len()); debug_assert!(frame.payload.len() + frame.mic.len() <= wire.len());' or similar bounds checks.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-16T20:19:57.839232Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-16T20:19:57.839232Z","labels":["error-handling","edge-case","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3.8","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-uka3","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-08-16T20:19:58.173168Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
